source_issues.finding: Generic coherent-topic and per-document distribution guarantees conflate LDA mixture with hard BERTopic assignments/outliers.
384 dimensions,~5 reduced dimensions and too-high-dimensional-for-clustering statements depend on model/backend.
Snippet does not return a normalized topic_word matrix; components sorting is not row normalization.
English stopwords and min_df2/max_df.9 can remove all vocabulary or mismatch other languages; library not run.
min_topic_size defaults and recommended50/100 thresholds depend on version and data; not installed or benchmarked.
Detailed NPMI/vector/cosine c_v description conflicts with glossary average-PMI simplification.
Distinct top-word fraction does not guarantee semantic separation or topic quality.
Length,resource,FASTopic speed and broad best/default choices are unverified source generalizations.
sqrt topic-count and5/200/40000 thresholds and refusal rules are heuristics; discovered BERTopic counts differ from requested counts. Prompt/20Newsgroups/coherence exercises not run.
ASCII regex drops CJK, truncates café and retains stopwords/short allowlist, unlike documented CountVectorizer processing.
Single chain/final assignments lack convergence/burn-in averaging evidence; negative iterations skip,True accepted as1topic,NaN alpha escapes validation,zero-count topics still list vocabulary.
SVG exact source payload preserved; static hash does not verify actual visibility. Canonical112lines lacks required citation header/tests;9doc300iteration demo is not production validation.
